about: Tests carried into trillion-workshop from Trillion-X/trillion (PR #243 deleted them there) whose subject is a trillion-apps screen or test help, so they cannot run here: each bundles an app screen that only trillion-apps web/ holds, or holds a bound the app's store answers. Retired from this repository at d18ac1922346f133c7a9b8bd3dd0fdf422122126 (tag retired/workshop-tests-of-trillion-apps-2026-11-07 holds them) by the owner's decision quoted in retired-paths.json; another lane lands them in trillion-apps web/test/ under their old trillion name, beside the screens they mount. Each test names its old trillion source (from, commit, source_identity: the receipt it had here) and its bytes here (identity).

tests.why: Its subject is trillion-apps web/test/import-source-for-tests.mjs (the ledger's subject_owner). It fails here: the greeting's reads grow with the record-log store's unmerged sorted runs (58 rows at N, about 150 at 4N, record_keys_run_* probed once per run), a bound the app's store answers.
It bundles and mounts the app screen src/workspace/lists-screen (mountListScreen) and src/workspace/records; no file of this repository holds either, they are trillion-apps web/ screens.
It bundles and mounts the app screen src/workspace/media-edit-screen (mountMediaEditScreen); no file of this repository holds it, it is a trillion-apps web/ screen.
It bundles and mounts the app screen src/workspace/public-apps-screen (mountPublicAppsScreen); no file of this repository holds it, it is a trillion-apps web/ screen.

It bundles and mounts the app screens src/workspace/tray-screen, tray and sharing-sheet and the app's parts/ui/show record-views and placeable-surface-intent; no file of this repository holds any of them, they are trillion-apps web/ screens.

It bundles and mounts the app screen src/workspace/home-screen (mountHomeCard) and src/workspace/person-notifications; its subject src/queued-work.json is trillion-apps web/src/queued-work.json (the ledger's subject_home).

test_cases.test: a loading block waits the look's reveal delay, then shows; reduced motion only shortens the animation
test_cases.why: It mounts the app's placeholder, parts/ui/show/screen-state (mountScreenState), whose home is trillion-apps web/parts/ui/show/screen-state/ScreenState.tsx (docs/worker-retirement-port-backlog.json); no file of this repository holds it. The file's other tests read this repository's look resolver and view transition and stay; the case is in the file at d18ac1922346f133c7a9b8bd3dd0fdf422122126.

test_cases.test: the iPhone app carries the current cover and needle
test_cases.why: It reads the iPhone app's copies of the cover and needle under ios/App (openingCoverFiles in tools/draw-trillions-app-icon-in-every-size-from/scripts/make-opening-cover.mjs writes them there); the iPhone app is a trillion-apps tree and no ios/ folder is in this repository. The file's other tests read this repository's cover and stay; the case is in the file at 3b41c0aecb54838e71ace08afe0a42d2fd76cd96.
